items.title: Cambridge, Trinity College, MS O.7.20, part 1, f. 33r: uroscopy wheel
items.source_locator: Catalogue Part 1 item 29, f. 1:33r; Part 1 History; Digital Images link
items.observed: 馆藏目录明确写出三个圆环、20个尿瓶，每瓶连到外圈说明；内圈七个小圆讨论若干瓶组共享的性质，中心另有题名。即有逐瓶说明和组级说明两个文本角色，但不能将组级说明擅当单瓶短标签。
items.two_text_roles: YES: individual-flask outer explanation versus grouped inner explanation, according to curator description.
items.short_label_to_sector_body: NOT YET VERIFIED: no evidence yet that each bottle has a separate short textual label suitable for the requested binary role.
items.image_location: Exact folio known; official CUDL viewer linked by catalogue. Tool access returned HTTP 403. No pixel-level confirmation in this task.
items.transcription: Catalogue transcribes the central rubric and snippets of adjacent texts only. Full sector text/labels not found or verified; do not mistake other catalogue entries marked Full transcription for this diagram.
next_evidence_needed: Open f. 1:33r in official viewer and locate each flask-to-text connection.
Check whether genuinely separate short labels exist; if absent, use only a broader multi-role diagram calibration.
Have a Latin palaeographer transcribe and independently annotate roles/regions before any matching.
items.suitability: Qualified candidate for spatial role annotation; not a ready label/body benchmark.

items.title: Rosenbach Museum & Library, MS 1004/29, Almanack: urine wheel

items.observed: 馆藏展览明确描述20个彩色尿瓶及颜色意义说明，目录确定为拉丁文折叠医师带书，年代1364。展览提供了这个圆图的特定图像直链。
items.two_text_roles: NOT CONFIRMED as two textual roles: flask images and explanatory text are confirmed, but image-versus-text is not short-label-versus-body.
items.short_label_to_sector_body: NOT YET VERIFIED: short textual labels may be present, but were not read; no per-sector mapping established.
items.image_location: Official image URL above is linked directly from exhibition. Search tool returned an image placeholder; separate native download returned HTTP 403, so do not claim visual inspection. Filename 9C is an image identifier, not a verified folio number.
items.transcription: No complete diagram transcription located on the read catalogue/exhibition pages. Descriptive catalogue text is not a transcription.
next_evidence_needed: Retrieve the official viewer image and verify a stable page/canvas identifier.
Identify short text labels separately from flask drawings and diagnostic paragraphs; retain absent/ambiguous cases.
Produce two-reader Latin transcription and region-to-flask annotation.
items.suitability: Publicly locatable circular diagram with known language; conditional candidate pending two-text-role verification.
